replace:
if (devTools !== null || true) {
      run(devTools as DevToolsModules);
why: Issue #1014. A press runs its answer at once whether or not the pane's modules have loaded, so before they land it reads a module that is not there and throws out of the click handler -- and nothing starts the load. The negative control for every `escapedDuring` check that a press before the load throws nothing.
